subject: E-Commerce
title: The Power of Good Defaults
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Power of Good Defaults.

hook.text: 90% of people never change default settings. Good defaults protect shoppers; bad defaults exploit them.

buildup.text: Default opt-in to marketing emails is a dark pattern. Default opt-in to privacy protection is ethical design.

discovery.text: Organ donation rates double in countries with opt-out defaults. Defaults are the most powerful design choice.

twist.text: Apple's default privacy settings hurt Facebook's ad business by $10 billion. One default changed an industry.

climax.text: Ethical defaults choose what's best for the user, not the company. The choice of default reveals values.

punchline.text: 90% keep the default. One setting choice can protect millions or exploit them.

quiz.question: How did Apple's default privacy settings impact Facebook?
options: Cost Facebook $10 billion in ad revenue
